misuse.text: Don't say 'for sure' if you might cancel.
misuse.why: It sounds like a firm promise.

native.tip: “for sure” = sem dúvida. Exemplo: “Pizza tonight? For sure!”
native.caption:
O que significa “for sure”?
“for sure” = sem dúvida.
Exemplo: “Pizza tonight? For sure!” (Pizza hoje à noite? "For sure"!)
